[SWS_Fr_00645] ⌈If stringent length check is enabled by configuration parameter (
FrRxStringentLengthCheck is true), then received data is accepted only if the
received payload length exactly matches the expected payload length as provided by
configuration parameter FrIfLSduLength. Otherwise FR_NOT_RECEIVED is written
to Fr_RxLPduStatusPtr and 0 is written to Fr_LSduLengthPtr .⌋
